architectures.driving_directive: operator FIELD directive — ONE unified surface of squares you push (hover-scroll bias) and zoom (drill) REPLACES the pad grid, the XY/vector pad, and the hierarchical drill-in entirely. Control/display layer only; ZERO engine diffs (F, world, LAMBDA, settlement, writer, render, provenance untouched; no new OSC address). Governing FIELD-INV: a square's brightness = live settled weight from read-only telemetry, never the input echoed (capability-guarded writer + static AST check, with bite fixtures). Bias enters ONLY via the panel's existing region-tilt lane (set_region_vector -> clamp -> slew -> /ets/lanes), soft-saturating and never hard-mute (crate/membership stays separate); drill depth self-sized by the participation-ratio noise-floor criterion (same anchors.effective_rank formula, restated not imported). Key files: ets/instrument/field.py (FieldModel/FieldView), live.py + app.py rewired, ets/panel/widget.py (XY vector pad removed; _RegionStrips kept as the section-8 region control), deleted ets/instrument/pads.py + tap.py, new harness ui-v6/tests/field/ (29 tests: FIELD-INV + FIELD-A..E) plus adapted pi/v5/instrument suites.
